trailer.subtitle: A preview
trailer.title: Our trailer
trailer.description: Before the big day, we'd love to share a little glimpse of what awaits us. A short trailer that tells a special moment of our story and opens the door to the most beautiful chapter yet.

story.afterDate: in Chieri, the place where we had already promised ourselves to one another during a simple and intimate civil ceremony. The next step, however, is the one we have always dreamed of sharing with you. On September 4th we will celebrate our union surrounded by the people who have made our journey so special. This is only the trailer... the best movie is yet to begin!

fragments.title: Memories we have shared
fragments.description: Our story began 7 years ago, almost by chance, through encounters, conversations and small moments that soon became important. Since then, we have shared journeys, plans and dreams.

ceremony.title: Ceremony
ceremony.description: Welcoming of the guests and beginning of the ceremony.

party.title: Party
party.description: Music, dancing and celebrations until late.

arrival.title: For those travelling from afar
arrival.description: Catania Airport is the main arrival point for guests travelling to Sicily by plane. From there, you can rent a car or take an Etna Trasporti bus, which provides frequent connections between Catania and Ragusa throughout the day.

directions.title: How to get there
directions.description: Relais Chiaramonte is easily accessible by car and is approximately 15 minutes from the centre of Ragusa. The venue has a large private car park reserved for guests.

accommodation.title: Where to stay
accommodation.description: For guests who would like to stay overnight, the Relais has a limited number of rooms available. Alternatively, Ragusa and the surrounding area offer many options, including hotels, B&Bs and holiday homes to suit every need.

donation.subtitle: A new chapter
donation.title: The most beautiful gift
donation.description: More than material gifts, we dream of experiences. The most beautiful gift would be the opportunity to continue discovering the world together, collecting memories that will stay with us for a lifetime. Should you wish to give us a gift, you can contribute to our journey while also supporting a cause that is especially close to our hearts.

travel.label: Honeymoon
travel.title: Our next journey
travel.description: Travelling is one of the things we love most. Every destination gives us something new, and every departure becomes a memory to cherish. By contributing, you will help us experience a new adventure together.

charity.label: Charity
charity.title: A gesture that goes beyond us
charity.description: We believe that a joyful occasion can also become an opportunity to do good. For this reason, part of the gifts we receive will be donated to an organization that works every day to help those who need it most.
charity.organizationDescription: A brief description of the organization's mission. You can replace this text once you have chosen the project you would like to support.

confirmation.question: When should we confirm our attendance?
confirmation.answer: Please confirm your attendance by the date that will be indicated in the invitation.

dressCode.question: Is there a dress code?
dressCode.answer: The dress code will be formal. We will add any further details here.

allergies.question: Can we communicate allergies or dietary restrictions?
allergies.answer: Yes. You will be able to indicate allergies, intolerances and dietary requirements in the RSVP form.

children.question: Are children invited?
children.answer: We will provide information here regarding children's participation.

parking.question: Is parking available?
parking.answer: Parking information will be added once confirmed.
